title: Verdant — The Ancient Forest Civilization
description: Verdant adds Malachite — a rare ore stronger than Netherite. Craft powerful tools with unique abilities, upgrade your armor, and explore a world shaped by an ancient forest civilization. NeoForge 26.1.1
body:
# 🌿 Verdant — The Ancient Forest Civilization

Deep beneath the forest floor lies a secret forgotten by time. An ancient civilization once thrived 
in the woodlands, leaving behind traces of their power — crystallized in a rare, beautiful mineral 
known as **Malachite**.

---

## 💎 Malachite — The New Tier

Malachite Ore spawns deep underground (Y: -64 to -32), rarer than Diamond and harder to obtain.
**Only a Netherite Pickaxe can mine it** — anything else yields nothing.

Smelt **Raw Malachite** → **Malachite Gem**, then upgrade your Netherite gear at a Smithing Table.
Malachite is stronger than Netherite in every way.

---

## ⛏️ Tools with Unique Abilities

Every Malachite tool has a special passive ability:

| Tool | Ability |
|------|---------|
| ⛏️ Pickaxe | 25% chance to double ore drops + 10% chance for Haste I (10s) |
| 🗡️ Sword | Applies **Poison** to enemies for 3 seconds on hit |
| 🪓 Axe | **Chops entire trees** in one swing (up to 100 logs) |
| 🥄 Shovel | Chance to dig up **Carrots** (10%) or **Beetroot Seeds** (20%) |
| 🌿 Hoe | Tills **3x3 farmland** in a single right-click |

---

## 🛡️ Malachite Armor

The armor of the ancient forest civilization carries its power:

- **Each piece worn** on grass, dirt or near trees → **Regeneration I** passive
- **Full set** → **Invisibility** effect, making hostile mobs ignore you in forests

Stats exceed Netherite:
- Durability: 20x multiplier (vs Netherite's 15x)
- Toughness: 5.0 (vs Netherite's 3.0)
- Knockback Resistance: 0.3 (vs Netherite's 0.1)

---

## 🌍 World Generation

Malachite Ore generates between **Y: -64 and Y: -32** in small veins.
Explore deep cave systems to find it.
Both **Malachite Ore** and **Deepslate Malachite Ore** variants exist.

---

## 🔮 Planned for Future Updates

This is just the beginning! Here's what's coming:

### 🐾 New Mobs
- 🦎 **Forest Lizard** — Neutral, can be tamed with dried herbs, sits on your shoulder
- 🌿 **Mossy Rabbit** — Lives only in forests, drops moss and herbs
- 🕷️ **Root Spider** — Underground near malachite, spits acid that slows you
- 🌱 **Thorn Golem** — Guardian of structures, slow but powerful, drops malachite
- 🦇 **Night Glider** — Active only at night, attacks in groups in cave structures

### 🏛️ New Structures
- 🌳 **Forest Sanctuary** — Stone ruins covered in vines, guarded by Thorn Golem
- ⛏️ **Forgotten Mine** — Underground tunnels filled with malachite veins and traps
- 🗼 **Ruined Tower** — 3-floor surface structure with loot on every floor

### 🌱 Herb System
- 5 new plants: **Forest Daisy**, **Emerald Leaf**, **Malachite Mushroom**, **Silver Grass**, **Black Berry**
- Dry herbs on a **Herb Rack** (new block)
- Brew them in a **Cauldron** to make 3 custom potions:
  - 🧪 Regeneration Brew
  - 🧪 Speed Brew
  - 🧪 Poison Resistance Brew
